name: auth-pages
title: Auth Pages
description: Public account screens for an app: sign-in, sign-up, check-email, verify-email, forgot-password, and reset-password panels and a centred page layout, with field validation, pending and failure states, and injected handlers that answer `{ ok: true }` or `{ ok: false, message }`, so they work with any router and any auth backend.
docs: Import: `import { AuthLayout, SignInPanel, SignUpPanel, VerifyEmailPanel } from '@/components/ui/auth-pages'`. Render one panel per route inside `AuthLayout`, pass your auth calls as handlers that return `{ ok: true }` or `{ ok: false, message }`, and pass your router's link once as `linkComponent` on the layout. Navigate after sign-in succeeds yourself; sign-up never expects a session and shows the check-email state instead.
